description: This file defines the RgbTint class, which handles color tinting operations, including conversions between RGB and HLS color spaces and applying tints to colors, within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: RgbTint
classes.description: A class to handle tint applied to colors, including color space conversions and tint calculations.

methods.name: rgbAndTintToRgb
methods.description: Converts RGB color values and a tint factor into a tinted RGB color represented as a hex string.
